_readme: Supplier page details for Golf Resort Magazine, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

Acushnet.line: Golf products company whose brands include Titleist and FootJoy.

Akkustation.line: Battery charging for golf carts, aimed at cutting fire risk.

Avison Young.line: Commercial real estate adviser offering property services across the UK.

Callaway.line: Maker of golf clubs, golf balls and golf equipment.

Canary Technologies.line: Hospitality software for guest experience, hotel operations and revenue.

Christie & Co.line: Specialist business and property adviser that buys, sells and values businesses, including hotels.

Club Car.line: Maker of golf carts, utility vehicles and low-speed vehicles.

Club Champion.line: Custom golf club fitting studios working across brands of heads, shafts and grips.

CourseRev.ai.line: AI tools for golf courses that automate tee time booking and customer service.

DETAILS.line: Portuguese hospitality management platform that runs a golf portfolio and resorts.

Elevate Golf.line: Golf tourism event that sets up appointments between golf destinations and tour operators.

Foremost Golf.line: Retail tools, technology and support for golf professionals.

Golf District.line: Tee time platform with a tool that lets golfers bid on sold-out tee times.

Husqvarna.line: Maker of mowers, robotic mowers and outdoor power tools for professionals and homeowners.

Indigo Sports.line: Troon division that manages municipal and lower-priced golf facilities.

ISEKI.line: Compact tractors and mowers, supplied by ISEKI UK and Ireland.

Jonas Club Software.line: Software, applications and services for private clubs.

LANDMARK.line: PR and brand marketing agency for golf courses, resorts and members' clubs.

Lightspeed Golf.line: Point of sale and management system for golf businesses.

Motocaddy.line: Electric and push golf trolleys, golf bags and accessories.

Paterson Golf.line: Customises and supplies caps, bags, towels, accessories and gifts to golf venues.

Pin Vision.line: Mobile platform for managing pin placements, pace of play and daily operations at golf clubs.

PSYenz.line: Golf venue experience research arm of Sport Psychology Ltd.

Rain Bird.line: Manufacturer of irrigation products and services.

Shiji.line: Hospitality technology for hotel operations, distribution, payments and guest engagement.

Syngenta.line: Agricultural science company whose products include turf insecticides.

TGI Golf.line: Retail services group supporting the businesses of PGA Professionals.

The Azalea Group.line: PR and marketing agency working across golf, travel and lifestyle.

Toptracer.line: Ball tracking technology for driving ranges.

Troon.line: Golf management company operating courses and clubs around the world.
